content.text: In regions where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-6|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-github-pages-free-digital-product-20|The Real]]-actually-2|payment]] processors like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, digital creators face significant barriers in automating their commerce. This challenge is especially prevalent in countries like Nigeria and Venezuela, where financial isolation limits the ability to sell digital products efficiently. Here, Google Apps Script emerges as a powerful tool for automating digital commerce, enabling creators to set up a streamlined order fulfillment process without relying on mainstream platforms.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows users to automate tasks across Google Workspace applications. For digital creators, this means automating the delivery of digital products once a payment is confirmed, significantly reducing manual fulfillment errors. By leveraging a correctly configured sovereign stack, orders can be processed in under 30 seconds, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation relies on a combination of webhooks and backend processes. When a payment is confirmed via NOWPayments, a webhook is triggered, executing a script that verifies the transaction and retrieves the customer's order. This process is facilitated by Cloudflare Workers, which can handle up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Manual fulfillment has specific failure modes that automated systems eliminate permanently. Time zone gaps cause hours-long delivery delays when buyers in Asia or Europe purchase while the seller is asleep in Africa. Notification fatigue causes orders to go unnoticed when webhook emails are buried in an inbox. Human error causes the wrong file to be sent or the wrong buyer to receive a link. Volume spikes overwhelm a manual process that functions at low order rates but breaks under simultaneous demand. The automated pipeline handles all of these cases identically — ten simultaneous orders from buyers in different time zones are processed as ten independent webhook events, each receiving the same automated treatment within 30 seconds.
Automate your digital product delivery with zero manual intervention.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include Cloudflare Workers for processing incoming webhook events, Google Sheets or Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive for delivering digital products. The integration of NOWPayments allows for automatic crypto payment verification, ensuring that once a payment is confirmed, the corresponding product is delivered without delay. This cohesive setup minimizes friction and maximizes efficiency in the fulfillment process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign stack, start by setting up a Cloudflare account and establishing your domain. Next, configure Google Sheets or Supabase to store orders, and integrate Google Apps Script to automate the workflow. Finally, connect your NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions seamlessly. For a more robust solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes comprehensive setup support and advanced features.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment data, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, and sends the delivery email with a time-limited download link.
Own your infrastructure and eliminate reliance on traditional payment platforms.

The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete technical implementation for both Stack 01 and Stack 02. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a webhook for order fulfillment?

To set up a webhook for order fulfillment, you need to configure your NOWPayments account to send payment confirmations to your Google Apps Script URL. This script should handle the incoming data, verify the payment, and process the order accordingly.
What are the advantages of using Cloudflare Workers?

Cloudflare Workers provide a highly scalable solution for handling incoming webhook events. They offer a free tier capable of processing up to 100,000 events daily, ensuring that your order fulfillment process remains efficient and responsive under varying loads.
Can I customize the email notifications sent to customers?

Yes, you can customize email notifications by modifying the Google Apps Script associated with your order fulfillment process. This allows you to tailor messages to align with your brand and provide important information to customers.
What payment methods can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to offer various payment options to your customers. This flexibility enhances your sales potential and caters to a broader audience in regions with limited access to traditional payment methods.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered securely?

To ensure secure delivery of digital products, utilize Google Drive or a similar service to host the files. Your Google Apps Script can generate secure download links that are sent to customers only after payment confirmation, protecting your content from unauthorized access.
